fusions.name: Beating Wind
fusions.desc: Spreads your strands into a sail and beats it once, dealing 14 wind damage to everything in a cone 4 tiles ahead of you and knocking it back 3.5 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Ballast Throw
fusions.desc: Hurls a weighted knot down a strand at the first enemy it meets, dealing 30 blunt damage. Every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it takes 80% of that.

fusions.name: Running Rigging
fusions.desc: Trims your strands to the wind, increasing your dodge chance by 20% for 12 seconds.
